text_block_list.text:
"Since Seiun Sky still hadn't shown up for 
practice, I went around asking where she 
might be, but..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Huh, Seiun Sky? She mentioned something 
about taking a nap in the library today.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
If you're looking for Seiun Sky-san, I 
believe she went to the field to harvest—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san? If I recall... she mentioned she 
was going to relax at a café.

After searching everywhere without 
success, I returned to the Trainer's 
Office at my wit's end, and—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Judging by the look of things, you 
fell right into Sei-chan's trap, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Don't worry, this is all part of the plan 
to make it look like you have your hands 
full with me, Trainer!”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I've been working way too 
diligently lately! A break was absolutely 
necessary, I tell you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, like they say, too much of a good 
thing can be just as bad as too little.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Something like that wouldn't work? I 
guess not, tee-hee☆

I made sure to properly warn Seiun Sky to 
be more careful in the future.
